name: Affection/Adoration/Absolution
source:
Charlotte has known Noel her entire life. Noel is all she has. Still, something about mom has seemed...different lately. What might be even scarier is that despite that, Char can't help but...

[From [url=https://mismatched-wings.itch.io/affectionadorationabsolution]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏洛特从记事起就一直与诺艾尔相依为命，诺艾尔便是她的全部。然而最近，妈妈身上似乎总透着一丝……异样。而或许更令人毛骨悚然的是，即便如此，小夏却依然情不自禁地……
